habitat: Pairs or groups in a wide variety of wooded habitats.
summary: A common resident. A small black bird with much white in the wings. The male has a heavier bill than Carp’s Tit and more white on the vent and undertail. Northern races may show more or less white on the folded wing than the illustration. The female is as illustrated or darker on the underparts, and the immature is similar. The calls are harsh and rasping: a rapid twiddy-zeet-zeet-zeet, or zeu-zeu-zeu-twit. Newman’s page uses the name Parus niger. This file keeps Melaniparus niger. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

research.note: Newman calls it a common resident, so status is resident and all twelve months are listed. The female is only “as illustrated or darker”, the immature is only “similar”, and northern races vary in wing white, which is why this needs review. Carp’s Tit is the comparison and is not in this list. Population figures and the Kemp code RB were left unchanged.
